details: The brush handler fires on every mousemove with no debouncing or RAF coalescing, iterating over all 105 dots and issuing two DOM mutations each (`.classed()` + `.attr()`) — totaling 210 DOM writes per frame. No infinite loop risk (single view, no dispatch), scales are static so no stale closure, no D3 transitions so no mid-flight race, and pointer events correctly unify mouse/touch input.
